derivation: contract C2 `hreflang_nonreciprocal`: A's manifest-internal target B has no alternates at all, so it cannot return A's url with tag en; A2 emits one finding for A's one offending annotation. B has no alternates, so no other clause applies to it.

<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
</head><body></body></html>
